description: Analyze an asset-allocation ('lazy') portfolio and get long-run performance computed from real monthly price history (proxy-extended for decades of data), not estimated: CAGR, max drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, Ulcer index, $10,000 growth, the number of independent bets (holdings whose returns average a correlation of 0.5 or more count as one group, then the effective count of groups by risk share), the top risk driver, trailing Sharpe, and a `validity` block (provenance, caveats, a reproduce-me hash) plus a `cite` block with the marketheist.io pages that show the same numbers. Use it for 'how did 60/40 / All Weather / Golden Butterfly perform' or for a custom mix. Provide exactly one of: a `template` id (19 model portfolios, listed in list_portfolios), a `strategy` id (7 rule-based canonical strategies, e.g. dual-momentum-gem) or a custom `assets` allocation (plain tickers and nested portfolios, rotations, strategies as holdings via `sleeve`). Template and strategy ids are answered from precomputed data through the stated month (instant, not rate-limited); custom assets and an `overlay` are computed live from market data. For seasonality and calendar years use portfolio_returns; for drawdown episodes and diversification use portfolio_risk; to compare portfolios use compare_portfolios. Read-only; surface the caveats when reporting.

assets.description: Custom allocation (omit if using `template` or `strategy`). Weights are percentages summing to ~100. A holding is a plain ticker OR a strategy node via `sleeve`.

sleeve.description: Advanced: a strategy node instead of a plain ticker — the app's SleeveRef, resolved server-side. Supported: a rotation/selection (`{source:'selection', config:{universe:[{ticker}], signal:{kind:'indicator', indicatorId, params} | {kind:'trailing-return', lookbackMonths, skipMonths (>= 1; the ranking for a month only sees data through the previous month-end)}, topK, weighting, rebalance}, label}`), a strategy-over-node (`{source:'strategy-over', child:{ticker}, config:<BacktestConfig>, label}`), a saved strategy preset (`{source:'backtest-live', ticker, frequency, config, presetId, label}`), a curated public-library strategy (`{source:'backtest-public', strategyId, label}`), a published backtest share (`{source:'backtest-share', shareId, label}`), a gallery template (`{source:'portfolio-public', templateId, label}`), or a nested portfolio (`{source:'portfolio-mine', portfolioId, config, label}`). Strategies with a config get a node-level overfit check (a share carries only its frozen curve, so no overfit).

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance ticker, e.g. VTI, BND, GLD. Omit when `sleeve` is given.

overlay.description: Optional portfolio-level trend-filter overlay applied to the WHOLE book: hold the entire portfolio only while its own level is above its N-month moving average, otherwise cash. Composition is monthly (a 10-month filter ≈ the classic 200-day one).

rebalance.description: Rebalancing cadence for custom portfolios (templates use their own).

strategy.description: Canonical rule-based strategy to analyze. One of: dual-momentum-gem, tsmom-sp500, faber-trend-timing, sector-momentum-rotation, risk-parity-inverse-vol, gtaa-aggressive, adaptive-asset-allocation. Answered from precomputed data. Omit when using `template` or `assets`.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio to analyze. One of: golden-butterfly, all-weather, permanent, dragon, faber-ivy, faber-gaa, bogleheads-3fund, wealthfront-classic, betterment-core, classic-60-40, classic-40-60, swensen, ferri-core-four, couch-potato, coffeehouse, no-brainer, larry, buffett-90-10, total-sp500. Omit to analyze a custom `assets` allocation instead.

name: analyze_portfolio
